refusal.emptyFileDescription: There's nothing in it to read. Check the file and upload it again, or paste your resume text.
refusal.passwordProtectedDescription: Remove the password (or export an unprotected copy) and upload it again, or paste your resume text.
refusal.invalidPdf: This isn't a PDF we can open
refusal.invalidPdfDescription: It may be damaged, or another kind of file renamed to .pdf. Export it again, upload a .docx, or paste your resume text.
refusal.tooManyPagesDescription: It has {{pages}} pages and we read up to {{max}}. Upload just your resume, not a combined document.
refusal.scannedOrEmpty: This PDF has no text we can read
refusal.scannedOrEmptyDescription: It looks like a scanned image. Upload a PDF exported from Word or Google Docs, a .docx, or paste your resume text.
refusal.legacyDoc: We can't open this Word file
refusal.legacyDocDescription: It's an older .doc file or a password-protected document. Save it as an unprotected .docx (File > Save As in Word), or paste your resume text.
refusal.noText: No text found in this document
refusal.noTextDescription: If your resume is inside an image or a text box, paste your resume text instead.
refusal.docxGarbled: This document's letters can't be read
refusal.docxGarbledDescription: Its text came out corrupted, usually because of a broken or embedded font. Save the document again, or paste your resume text.
refusal.txtUnreadable: This file isn't text we can read
refusal.txtUnreadableDescription: It may be another kind of file renamed to .txt. Save your resume as plain text again, upload a PDF or .docx, or paste your resume text.
refusal.webExport: This document was saved as web content
refusal.webExportDescription: We can't read it directly. Open it in Word and use File > Save As > Word Document (.docx), or paste your resume text.
refusal.rateLimitedDescription: Please wait a while and try again, or paste your resume text.

notice.rtlUnreliable: Some letters may be out of order
notice.rtlUnreliableDescription: PDFs don't keep joined Arabic letters reliably, so parts of this text may read out of order. For the most accurate scan, upload a .docx or paste your resume text.
notice.imagePagesSkippedDescription: Pages with no text we could read: {{pages}}. We read the rest. If those pages are part of your resume, upload a .docx or paste the text.
